text:
maria: FYI — paging storm started at 06:12 UTC, routed to infra oncall. We escalated to SRE and rolled a temporary silence on the high-rate error alert while we triage.

incident-bot: [06:12] pager triggered: service_high_error_rate (pagerduty#12345) — 1500 errors/min across prod cluster.

aj: tl;dr on cause? network flapping or backpressure?

devon: initial traces show surge in retries from the new batch-ingest job hitting redis. Needs looking into but probably noisy rather than full outage.

nina: confirmed customer impact = increased 5xxs for realtime inference; ~12% of requests saw degraded latency, but fallbacks served responses. No data exfiltration.

maria: good. i'm going to add the 2-hour silence and open a maintenance window for the next deploy. Patch plan: throttle batch-ingest, revert backoff settings.

chris: please post the exact command you used to silence the alert so I can replicate for other noisy thresholds.

maria: ops UI -> Alerts -> service_high_error_rate -> Silence -> duration 2h -> reason "batch-ingest retry storm". CLI form if needed:
```
alertctl silence --alert service_high_error_rate --until "$(date -d '+2 hours' --utc +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" --note "batch-ingest retry storm"
```

aj: thanks. After we stabilize we should revisit the threshold and add a fingerprint to avoid paging for known transient spikes. I'm putting a TODO on the monitoring board.

devon: can we also create a temporary dashboard tile showing request retry rates + job concurrency for the batch-ingest service? would help validate fix.

maria: yes — created: Dashboard "ingest/retries" with panels: job_concurrency, redis_err_rate, request_5xx_rate. Link: https://grafana.internal/d/abcdef/ingest-retries

ops-bot: Maintenance window created by maria from 2026-03-15T06:15:00Z to 2026-03-15T08:15:00Z — ID mw-20260315-01

nina: handoff note for next oncall: we throttled batch-ingest by reducing concurrency from 40 -> 8, rolled back aggressive retry policy, and silenced the noisy alert for 2h. customer impact limited to higher latencies; no data loss.

chris: devon — can you validate that new concurrency + backoff fixes reduce retry floods? share a small eval script or queries.

devon: running quick smoke now:
```
# tail -n 200 /var/log/ingest/worker.log | grep retry | wc -l
# prometheus query: sum(rate(job_retry_total[5m])) by (job)
```
Initial numbers: retries dropped from ~2k/min -> ~40/min after throttle.

maria: awesome. once we see stable numbers for 30m, i'll lift the silence and then we can tune the alert. Current alert triggers at >300 errors/min sustained for 2m — I propose changing to >600 errors/min for bursty systems + add an alert label to ignore if maintenance window active.

aj: +1 on adding maintenance-window exemption. Also suggest adding a composite alert: if errors+latency both high then page, otherwise log only. Reduces noise.

chris: agree. For validation, let's add a canary rule: change threshold in staging to 600/min for 2m and run synthetic load for 10m to confirm we don't miss regressions.

nina: i'm documenting customer-impact timeline in the incident ticket:
- 06:12 alarm fired
- 06:16 silence + maintain window created
- 06:20 throttle deploy rolled (concurrency -> 8)
- 06:30 retries dropped to baseline
- 06:45 started verification
- 07:05 canary pass

maria: handoff for next oncall @aj — please monitor dashboard and be ready to extend silence or escalate if retries spike again. Also validate the silence expiry flow; last time expiry auto-unmuted and paged us.

aj: noted. Setting a 5min reminder at 08:05 UTC to check and lift silence manually if safe.

incident-bot: [08:15] silence mw-20260315-01 will expire in 10 minutes — scheduled alert un-silence at 2026-03-15T08:15:00Z

devon: quick thought — we should tag the alert with fingerprint 'batch-ingest' so future noise isn't mixed with unrelated infra errors. I'll open a PR to add fingerprinting and composite rule logic.

maria: thanks. After this thread ends, please follow these follow-ups:
- devon: PR for alert fingerprint + composite rule (due EOD)
- chris: staging test for new thresholds (due tomorrow)
- aj: post-incident validation doc with screenshots of dashboards and the silence lifecycle check (due EOD)
- nina: incident summary for customers (send by 10:00 UTC)

aj: copied. i'll add tasks to the incident ticket and ping when the manual un-silence check is done. :white_check_mark:

maria: closing the active mitigation. leaving the incident page in postmortem mode. if anyone sees reoccurrence, reopen thread. thanks team :heart:
